title.value: M ASAKHA NEWS: News Topic Classification for African Languages
title.justification: The paper focuses on creating a dataset for news topic classification for African languages and outlines various methods for evaluating the effectiveness of existing models.
title.quote: In this paper, we develop MasakhaNEWS — a new benchmark dataset for news topic classification covering 16 languages widely spoken in Africa.

extractions.description: The paper introduces MasakhaNEWS, a benchmark dataset for news topic classification covering 16 African languages. It explores the challenges of dataset scarcity and evaluation gaps in African languages and provides baseline evaluations using machine learning and language models. Various approaches for zero-shot and few-shot learning for these special low-resource languages are assessed.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The central theme of the paper is to advance NLP capabilities in African languages. While it addresses the scarcity of high-quality datasets for these languages, it does not directly focus on any sustainable development goals.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: In this paper, we address two problems of lack of evaluation datasets, and lack of extensive evaluation of LLMs for African languages.

primary_category.justification: The paper mainly supports the need for advancing applications and developing tools in the Global South, with a focus on African languages, representing a major under-represented area in NLP research.
primary_category.quote: We create MasakhaNEWS — a large-scale news topic classification dataset covering 16 typologically-diverse languages widely spoken in Africa.

primary_sub_category.justification: The effort to build and share a comprehensive dataset with open-access for African languages fits the category of knowledge sharing and policy advice, as it empowers local communities in African regions to improve technological engagement through NLP.
primary_sub_category.quote: We hope that MasakhaNEWS encourages the NLP community to benchmark and evaluate LLMs on more low-resource languages.

applications.value: Development of news topic classification datasets for low-resource African languages
applications.justification: The application of creating and utilizing datasets for language development aligns with the paper's goal of advancing language model applications in under-represented areas.
applications.quote: ...a large-scale news topic classification dataset covering 16 typologically-diverse languages widely spoken in Africa including English and French, with the same label categories across all languages.

new_primary_category.justification: The existing category 'Support to Global South' appropriately classifies the paper's intent to improve NLP resources for African languages, so no new category is required.
new_primary_category.quote: The effort to provide a comprehensive dataset for African languages aims at enhancing technological capabilities in the Global South.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The existing sub-category 'Policy Advice and Knowledge Sharing' effectively captures the paper’s emphasis on distributing knowledge resources and datasets for the Global South.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: We provide an extensive evaluation using both full-supervised and few-shot learning settings.
